mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_status = 'NORMAL') AS normal_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM underpass WHERE is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass u WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS facility_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass u WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.current_status = 'BLOCKED' AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS blocked_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plate_log p JOIN underpass_camera c ON c.id = p.camera_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = c.underpass_id WHERE p.review_status = 'PENDING' AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS pending_review_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass_transit t JOIN underpass u ON u.id = t.underpass_id WHERE t.status = 'REMAINING' AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS remaining_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event e ON e.id = a.event_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = e.underpass_id WHERE a.sent_at >= date_trunc('day', NOW()) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS alerts_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass u JOIN threshold t ON t.underpass_id = u.id AND t.level = '위험' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rs2.risk_score FROM risk_score rs2 WHERE rs2.underpass_id = u.id ORDER BY rs2.predicted_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) rs ON TRUE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND rs.risk_score IS NOT NULL AND rs.risk_score >= t.risk_score_min AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS danger_level_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass u JOIN threshold t ON t.underpass_id = u.id AND t.level = '위험' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rs2.risk_score FROM risk_score rs2 WHERE rs2.underpass_id = u.id ORDER BY rs2.predicted_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) rs ON TRUE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND rs.risk_score IS NOT NULL AND rs.risk_score < t.risk_score_min AND (t.risk_score_min - rs.risk_score) <= #{nearMargin} AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}) AS near_danger_count

SELECT u.id AS underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, rs.risk_score, rs.predicted_at FROM underpass u LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rs2.risk_score, rs2.predicted_at FROM risk_score rs2 WHERE rs2.underpass_id = u.id ORDER BY rs2.predicted_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) rs ON TRUE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY u.name

SELECT 'EVENT' AS kind, e.underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, e.event_type, e.risk_level, e.risk_score_at_event, NULL::display_message_type AS message_type, e.operator_id, e.created_at FROM underpass_event e JOIN underpass u ON u.id = e.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} UNION ALL SELECT 'DISPLAY' AS kind, d.underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, NULL::underpass_event_type, NULL::risk_level, NULL::DECIMAL(4,3), d.message_type, d.operator_id, d.created_at FROM display_log d JOIN underpass u ON u.id = d.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} UNION ALL SELECT 'ALERT' AS kind, ue.underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, NULL::underpass_event_type, NULL::risk_level, NULL::DECIMAL(4,3), NULL::display_message_type, NULL::bigint, a.sent_at FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event ue ON ue.id = a.event_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = ue.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id AS underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, r.name AS region_name, t.level, t.risk_score_min, t.updated_at FROM threshold t JOIN underpass u ON u.id = t.underpass_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = u.region_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY u.name, t.risk_score_min ASC

SELECT u.id AS underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, r.name AS region_name, rs.risk_score, t.risk_score_min AS danger_threshold, (t.risk_score_min - rs.risk_score) AS margin FROM underpass u LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = u.region_id JOIN threshold t ON t.underpass_id = u.id AND t.level = '위험' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rs2.risk_score FROM risk_score rs2 WHERE rs2.underpass_id = u.id ORDER BY rs2.predicted_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) rs ON TRUE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND rs.risk_score IS NOT NULL AND u.region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY margin ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT date_trunc('day', rs.predicted_at)::date AS trend_date, AVG(rs.risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, MAX(rs.risk_score) AS max_risk_score FROM risk_score rs JOIN underpass u ON u.id = rs.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND rs.predicted_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId} GROUP BY trend_date ORDER BY trend_date

SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, COUNT(u.id) FILTER (WHERE u.current_risk_level = '안전') AS safe_count, COUNT(u.id) FILTER (WHERE u.current_risk_level = '경고') AS warning_count, COUNT(u.id) FILTER (WHERE u.current_risk_level = '위험') AS danger_count, COUNT(u.id) AS total_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN underpass u ON u.region_id = r.id AND u.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE r.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.id = #{regionId} GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name

WITH ordered AS ( SELECT e.underpass_id, e.event_type, e.created_at, LEAD(e.event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY e.underpass_id ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id) AS next_type, LEAD(e.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.underpass_id ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id) AS next_at FROM underpass_event e JOIN underpass u ON u.id = e.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND e.event_type IN ('BLOCK', 'RELEASE') AND e.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId} ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'BLOCK') AS block_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'RELEASE') AS release_count, (SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_at - created_at))) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'BLOCK' AND next_type = 'RELEASE') / 60)::bigint AS total_duration_minutes, (AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_at - created_at))) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'BLOCK' AND next_type = 'RELEASE') / 60)::bigint AS avg_duration_minutes FROM ordered

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.alert_type = 'PREDICTIVE') AS predictive_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.alert_type = 'ROI_FINAL') AS roi_final_count FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event e ON e.id = a.event_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = e.underpass_id WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.sent_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} AND u.id = #{underpassId}

SELECT m.id AS manager_id, emp.name AS manager_name, COALESCE(ev.block_count, 0) AS block_count, COALESCE(ev.release_count, 0) AS release_count, COALESCE(dl.display_count, 0) AS display_log_count, COALESCE(ev.block_count, 0) + COALESCE(ev.release_count, 0) + COALESCE(dl.display_count, 0) AS total_count FROM manager m JOIN employee emp ON emp.id = m.employee_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.operator_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'BLOCK') AS block_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'RELEASE') AS release_count FROM underpass_event e JOIN underpass u ON u.id = e.underpass_id WHERE e.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN ('BLOCK', 'RELEASE') AND e.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} GROUP BY e.operator_id ) ev ON ev.operator_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.operator_id, COUNT(*) AS display_count FROM display_log d JOIN underpass u ON u.id = d.underpass_id WHERE d.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND u.region_id = #{regionId} GROUP BY d.operator_id ) dl ON dl.operator_id = m.id WHERE m.status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND (ev.block_count IS NOT NULL OR dl.display_count IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY total_count DESC
